_comment: Headlines are authored as explicit lines so the break point is a design decision, not a wrapping accident. Keep each line under ~24 characters or it will wrap a third time and push the device off-canvas.

headline: Find opportunities
built for you
shots.nav: Launch app — lands on the home tab. Scroll to the top before capturing.

headline: Know your
real chances
shots.sub: See how you fit before you apply
shots.nav: Open any opportunity card with a populated match-fit section.

headline: A coach that
knows your story
shots.sub: Ask anything. Get a plan, not a lecture.
shots.nav: Chat tab. Scroll so a full question-and-answer exchange is visible.

headline: Never miss
a deadline
shots.nav: Deadlines tab, or Saved if it shows more populated rows.

headline: Turn a goal
into a roadmap
shots.sub: Step by step, week by week
shots.nav: Goals tab, then open a roadmap with visible steps.

headline: Build a CV
that gets read
shots.nav: CV builder. Show the editor with content, not the empty start screen.
